lines.text: ColonBroom’s GLP-1 Booster is sold as a natural GLP-1 supplement for appetite control. We read the label. Here is what it actually says.
lines.say: Colon Broom's G L P one Booster is sold as a natural G L P one supplement, for appetite control. We read the label. Here is what it actually says.

lines.text: The headline ingredient is berberine. But the panel lists 200 milligrams of Berberis bark powder. That is the weight of the ground bark, not of the berberine inside it.
lines.say: The headline ingredient is berberine. But the panel lists two hundred milligrams of Berberis bark powder. That is the weight of the ground bark, not of the berberine inside it.

lines.text: The weight research used more than 1,000 milligrams of berberine a day. Even if every milligram in this capsule were berberine, it would be a fifth of that.
lines.say: The weight research used more than one thousand milligrams of berberine a day. Even if every milligram in this capsule were berberine, it would be a fifth of that.

lines.text: The other two plant extracts, resveratrol and quercetin, showed no significant effect on body weight in their own meta-analyses.
lines.say: The other two plant extracts, resveratrol and quercetin, showed no significant effect on body weight in their own meta-analyses.

lines.text: And the GLP-1 claim? There is no trial of the product. The two papers the brand cites are a pathway review and a cell study.
lines.say: And the G L P one claim? There is no trial of the product. The two papers the brand cites are a pathway review, and a cell study.

lines.text: Three different formulas have been sold under this name since April 2025, with four different sets of directions.
lines.say: Three different formulas have been sold under this name since April twenty twenty-five, with four different sets of directions.

lines.text: On our five criteria it scores 2 for evidence, 1 for dose, 3 for label transparency, 2 for value and 6 for safety. Overall: 2.8 out of 10.
lines.say: On our five criteria, it scores two for evidence, one for dose, three for label transparency, two for value, and six for safety. Overall: two point eight out of ten.

lines.text: If you want to try berberine, buy a product that states how much berberine you are getting. This is a desk review of the label and published research, not medical advice. The full review, with every source, is at sharpandlean.com.
